The '''Shaum Hii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
